categories.title: New Features
list: Armor icons: draw how the trim looks on armor items in the inventory, with a preview on every armor type and trim material
Armor icon generators: from the trim on the player, the vanilla overlay or simple shapes
Armor icons are exported in the Visual Armor Trims format, into Visual Armor Trims itself if the pack contains it

categories.title: Improvements
list: Vanilla palettes are only added to the atlas for Minecraft versions that have them (copper_darker, resin)
Several trims can be opened from a resource pack at once, each in its own tab; a trim that is already open gets its tab back
Export only rewrites files whose content changed and keeps the line endings of edited JSON files
Re-exporting armor icons keeps the order of existing item model cases
